note: Corrections from KiCad's placement export to JLCPCB's placement file, per KiCad footprint. KiCad reports a through-hole part at pin 1 and uses its own zero angle; JLCPCB places its part model at the body centre with the model's zero angle. offset_mm is the model centre in the footprint's own frame (KiCad x right, y down, before rotation); rot_deg is added to KiCad's angle. Every row was read from JLCPCB's placement preview for this board (order page, 2026-11-12): pin-1 dot of the model against the silkscreen triangle for chips, body outline against the silkscreen outline for connectors.
